arithmetic: 30% fall: (5,500 - 3,800) / 5,500 = 30.9%. From CBS peak 5,589: (5,589 - 3,800) / 5,589 = 32.0%. From 3,881 (12 Nov): 30.6% from 5,589. Spoken 'about thirty, a little more at the low' and on-screen -30% are within this range. OK.

Gold-loan example: LTV at start = 75 / 100 = 75% (the cap). After the fall to 80: 75 / 80 = 93.75%, about 94%, which is over the 75% cap. The numbers are right; l060 should say the LTV (new_issue above).
Bar value: 400 troy oz x 3,800 = $1,520,000 (about $1.5 million, OK). At 3,881 it would be $1,552,400. Bar weight: 400 x 31.1035 g = 12,441 g = 12.44 kg (on-screen 12.4 kg OK).

Cube: 224,000 t / 19.3 t per m3 = 11,606 m3. Cube root = 22.64 m (224,200 t gives 22.65 m). On-screen ~22.6 m OK. Spoken 'twenty-two and a half' (22.5) is wrong: it would need a density of 19.67 t/m3 (new_issue l091).
'About nine years': 2020 - 2011 = 9 years (peak 2011, first back above in Aug 2020 per one source). OK.

'Under ten months': 28 Jan 2026 to 16 Nov 2026 = 292 days = 9.6 months (30 Jan to 16 Nov = 290 days = 9.5 months). True only when measured from late January, as l041 does; from 1 January it would be 10.5 months. OK as written.
Dates: 30 Jan 2026 = Friday; 29 Jan 2026 = Thursday; 30 Jan is two days after the 28 Jan record. OK.
